faq.start_1_q: How do I add my family?
faq.start_1_a: Open Family, tap Invite and share the code. Children join with a child code from your phone.
faq.loc_1_q: Why is a location not updating?
faq.loc_1_a: Check that location is On and set to "Allow all the time", the phone has internet, and battery saver is not limiting Nirapod.
faq.loc_2_a: No. It updates more often when moving and rests when still. Typical use is a few percent a day.
faq.sos_1_q: What happens when someone presses SOS?
faq.sos_1_a: Every adult in the family gets a loud alert with the live location, plus an email. You see who has seen it.
faq.fam_1_a: No. Sharing is always visible with a notification, adults must agree, and you can pause anytime.
faq.bill_1_a: Live location and SOS are always free. Premium adds more members, places and longer history.
faq.priv_1_a: Only the family members you share with. Nirapod staff and support never see locations.
